services.name: First Skydive
services.desc: Experienced skydivers from across the US and the world call Skydive Paraclete XP home. Whether you’re a fun jumper looking for a weekend home or a team looking to train for an upcoming competition, Skydive Paraclete XP has everything you need! One of the longest operating dropzones in the country, Skydive Paraclete XP (formerly Raeford Parachute Center) is located at PK Airpark in Raeford, NC just minutes from Fayetteville. Our long-standing reputation as the training ground for the World’s best skydivers combined with our fleet of turbine aircraft, modern amenities, and on-site wind tunnel have made us the dropzone of choice for experienced skydivers in The Research Triangle and beyond. services.desc: Skydive Paraclete XP has an impressive fleet of onsite skydiving aircraft. Each one of our airplanes is maintained to the highest standard. Our variety of aircraft means we can offer a range of capabilities too; for skydiving teams in particular, this can be a real benefit as the selection of exit doors for you to try is an advantage for team training. As a first time skydiver, you’re guaranteed to have a comfortable and quick ride to altitude no matter which of our aircraft you fly in. You’ll receive tandem skydiving training to explain how to exit your specific aircraft.
